text_block_list.text: On my day off, I went out shopping, when――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

Mejiro Dober was squeezed out of the 
bustling general store.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hah, failed again. The aroma... My hands 
were right within reach just now, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh... N-Not really.
choice_data_list: Didn't you come here to buy something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It has nothing to do with you. ...It's no 
big deal anyway. I've already given up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're persistent. I told you, I've given 
up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fine, go ahead and say I can't even buy a 
decent present for my relatives... Hmph.
choice_data_list: Why not look for a different present?
Steel your resolve and charge right in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Truth is, one of my younger relatives 
seemed pretty exhausted, so I thought I'd 
give them some aroma oils, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's a sale today, so it's packed. I 
can't push my way inside at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time to head home, so I was 
wondering what to do.
choice_data_list: Why not look for a different present?
Steel your resolve and charge right in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What's with this all of a sudden? What do 
you mean, "a different present"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A different present, huh... I hadn't even 
thought of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, I believe 
she... liked Mont Blanc...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I copied you or anything. 
It just popped into my head. ...See ya.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What would cheer her up...? Last time, she 
seemed really happy when I made her a Mont 
Blanc.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds good. Let's do that. 
Hehe, looking at things from another 
perspective is important, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think I'll save the 
aromatherapy for next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ……What's that supposed to mean? Are 
you saying my resolve wasn't strong 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Should I charge through...? Will it be 
okay? I couldn't even take a single step 
forward just now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, but I really don't want to give 
up. I want to see her get well again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna go battle the crowd. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That does it. You want me to go, fine! 
I'll go!

With that, she stepped forward toward the 
bustling shop.

Having safely gotten the aroma blend, she 
stepped out of the shop, murmured, "I 
wonder if McQueen will like it," and 
hurried off.
